items.summary:

possible.

* WHERE...Delta Junction, Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp,
and Northern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...From Thursday evening through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Isolated power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult,
especially for high profile vehicles.
